ask: dma.cpp: a memory-access layer for an FPGA-backed physical-memory device. It must expose device_read(phys_addr, buf, len) / device_write(phys_addr, buf, len) over an abstract 'MemProc' interface (open/close/read/write of physical ranges), translate a virtual address to physical by walking a four-level page table read through that same interface (PML4/PDPT/PD/PT, 4 KiB and 2 MiB pages), and provide scatter_read(list of (virt_addr,len)) batching contiguous runs. Include a --selftest mode that registers an in-memory fake MemProc and asserts the walk and the scatter path. C++17, no external deps, windows headers only for the real backend behind #ifdef.
